newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields:3-,6-mo same,9-,12-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields:3-,6-mo same,9-,12-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and six-month treasury bills were unchanged, and yields on nine- and 12-month bills fell from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.47 percent, six-month bills stayed at 31.27 percent, nine-month bills eased to 34.84 percent from 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills slipped to 39.89 percent from 39.93 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.00 million UAH 4.30 million UAH
Amount sold 6.00 million UAH 2.05 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.65 million UAH 1.94 million UAH
The central bank sold 60,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 16.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35.00 million UAH 23.00 million UAH
Amount sold 9.77 million UAH 7.65 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.45 million UAH 6.62 million UAH
The central bank sold 97,663 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 16.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 2.28 million UAH 1.10 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.80 million UAH 0.87 million UAH
The central bank sold 22,760 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is April 16.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35.00 million UAH 23.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.33 million UAH 12.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.39 million UAH 9.07 million UAH
The central bank sold 103,285 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 16.
